info.title: Innostes ERP API
info.description:
Backend API for **Innostes ERP**.

### Conventions
* **Ids** are UUIDs.
* **Timestamps** are ISO 8601 in UTC.
* Every record has `id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`,
  `updated_by`, `deleted_at` and `deleted_by`.
* **Delete is a soft delete**: the record is hidden, not removed, and can be
  restored. Lists hide deleted records unless `include_deleted=true`.
* **Pagination**: list endpoints take `offset` and `limit` and return
  `{items, total, offset, limit}`.
* **Errors** return `{"detail": "..."}`; validation errors (422) return a
  list of field problems.

### Authentication
Send `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. For now the token is optional
and only used to record who made a change.

get.description: Service name, environment, status and the list of loaded modules.
Public configuration and app metadata for frontend bootstrapping.

Report API, database and per-module health.

Returns **200** with `status: "pass"` when the database responds,
otherwise **503** with `status: "fail"`.

post.description: Authenticates credentials, evaluates device trust, and issues short-lived JWT and single-use refresh token.
Rotates a single-use refresh token, detecting reuse attempts, and returns fresh tokens.
Dispatches email containing temporary password and one-click reset link. Anti-enumeration protected.

post.summary: Reset password with email link token
post.description: Consumes single-use signed reset token, checks SOC 2 password history, and sets new password.
Changes password for authenticated user (required on first login or after temporary password usage).
Revokes current session refresh token or all active sessions across all devices.

get.description: Returns the profile and identity details of the authenticated actor.

Tell the UI whether to show the setup wizard. Reveals nothing else.

Returns **503** if the database can't be reached: the setup state is
unknown then, so the UI must not show the wizard.

503.description: A required service (e.g. the database) is unavailable

get.description:
Check the database before installing. Requires the `X-Setup-Token` header.

The wizard also uses it to verify the token. Returns **404** once setup is
complete or when web setup is disabled.

503.description: A required service (e.g. the database) is unavailable

post.description:
Install the system: create the database tables and the first organisation.

Requires the `X-Setup-Token` header. Works **only once**: afterwards this
route returns **404**, as if it never existed.

503.description: A required service (e.g. the database) is unavailable

post.description:
Create a new tenant (customer organisation).

If a valid bearer token is sent, its user is recorded in `created_by`
and `updated_by`. Returns **409** if the slug is already used.

get.description:
List tenants with pagination, newest first.

Soft-deleted tenants are hidden unless `include_deleted=true`.

200.description: One page of tenants, newest first.

get.description: Get one tenant by id. Soft-deleted tenants return 404.

patch.description:
Change a tenant. Only the fields you send are updated.

The calling user (from the bearer token) is recorded in `updated_by`.
Soft-deleted tenants return 404; restore them first.

delete.description:
Soft-delete a tenant: it is hidden from lists but kept in the database.

Sets `deleted_at` and `deleted_by`. Undo with
`POST /tenants/{tenant_id}/restore`.

200.description: The tenant, now marked as deleted.

post.description:
Bring back a soft-deleted tenant.

Clears `deleted_at` and `deleted_by`. Calling it on an active tenant
is harmless.
Registers a new user identity with envelope-encrypted PII.

get.description: Retrieves a user account and decrypts their PII.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User login, refresh token rotation, anti-enumeration forgot-password, and credential updates.

tags.name: Setup
tags.description: First-run installation. `GET /setup/status` tells the UI whether to show the setup wizard. `GET /setup/checks` and `POST /setup` require the `X-Setup-Token` header (printed in the server log on first start) and return 404 once setup is complete. Until then, other routes return 503 with `code: setup_required`.

tags.name: Tenancy
tags.description: Tenants are the customer organisations using the ERP. Every business record belongs to a tenant. Deleting a tenant is a soft delete and can be undone with *restore*.
